item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Extended autoMOTIVE Security with AI (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-31 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma, Rm
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-03 Infrastrutture e sistemi di trasporto, estimo e valutazione

Urban mobility has undergone a significant push toward the use of soft mobility or micro-mobility transport modes. This operational scenario requires the development of new methodologies for assessing urban safety, especially with regard to vulnerable users. Activities will include: 1) the development and calibration of new predictive models of pedestrian crowding in urban areas based on GIS-type architectures and employing hybrid natural configurational approaches; 2) the development ofmicro-mobility severity assessment functions; and 3) in-depth study of the design of vertical traffic calming devices

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development of innovative and sustainable processes for the valorization of different types of inorganic waste and residues (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-26 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-02 Ingegneria sanitaria-ambientale, ingegneria e sicurezza degli scavi, delle materie prime, degli idrocarburi e fluidi nel sottosuolo

The project's objective is to identify and test treatment trains for specific types of inorganic waste and residues (e.g., steel mill slag, waste-to-energy residues, construction and demolition residues) aimed at recovering high-value materials (such as metals, silica, calcium carbonate) using regenerable reagents and/or by-products from other processes. Furthermore, processes that allow for the permanent storage of carbon dioxide will be tested, helping to reduce the process's greenhouse gas emissions. The environmental and technical compatibility of the resulting products will also be assessed based on their intended use

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Experimental validation of monitoring systems for rigid pavements and concrete elements based on embedded fiber optic sensing (Univ. ROMA TRE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 23:59
Institution: Univ. ROMA TRE, Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-03 Infrastrutture e sistemi di trasporto, estimo e valutazione

The Research Group operating within the academic discipline of CEAR 03/A has constructed full-scale test sections under controlled conditions, in which the rigid pavements and concrete elements have been instrumented using FBG optical fibre sensors embedded directly into the concrete.The research activity covered by this call will therefore focus on validating the performance of the prototype system. Validation will be carried out through a statistical comparison of the experimental data with the results obtained using the main models available in the literature, including the Westergaard, Thomlison and FAA models.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: LLM based Digital Twin for Asset and Facility Management - 2026_IDR_DABC_9 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-08 Design, tecnologia dell'architettura, architettura tecnica e gestione dell'ambiente costruito

Digital Twins (DTs) integrate sensor-generated data with geometric, semantic, and contextual information from Building Information Modelling (BIM), supporting the management and maintenance of buildings and infrastructure. However, their adoption in Asset and Facility Management (A&FM) is often constrained by the complexity of accessing and interpreting heterogeneous data. This research will investigate the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) as natural-language interfaces to Digital Twins, enabling users to access and interpret data without advanced technical expertise. It will develop and validate an LLM-enabled framework to transform Digital Twin data into actionable information…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development of algorithms, logic, and models for processing drone-acquired data to quantify asbestos-containing materials (ACMs) and remotely map surfaces. (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-09 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-02 Ingegneria sanitaria-ambientale, ingegneria e sicurezza degli scavi, delle materie prime, degli idrocarburi e fluidi nel sottosuolo

Development within a Python environment of spectral libraries, chemometric procedures for processing drone-acquired hyperspectral data, and classification and model-selection algorithms aimed at identifying asbestos-containing materials (ACM). Activities include integrated field-to-laboratory validation, asbestos fiber quantification, thematic map generation, and GIS integration, all aimed at establishing procedural and operational guidelines. The role requires expertise in hyperspectral imaging, chemometrics, and remote sensing data analysis, as well as proficiency in ENVI and specialized hyperspectral processing software.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Tools of artificial intelligence for coastal erosion assessment (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-25 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-01 Idraulica, idrologia, costruzioni idrauliche e marittime

The research objective is to develop and validate AI-based tools for assessing coastal erosion, with a specific focus on estimating shoreline retreat following storm surges. Specifically, the aim is to develop a machine learning model (such as neural networks, decision trees, random forests, or hybrid approaches) capable of analyzing multi-source data, including satellite imagery and coastal survey datasets, to predict shoreline morphological changes over different time scales.

First, classical "supervised" operational modal analysis algorithms will be applied to identify the dynamic characteristics and localize anomalies. This application will primarily focus on specific bridges which are currently under study as part of the "2026-ANAS_SHM-POLIMI_DABC" Agreement between Consorzio Fabre and Politecnico di Milano. item.description:

Institution: Politecnico TORINO, Torino
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-08 Design, tecnologia dell'architettura, architettura tecnica e gestione dell'ambiente costruito

The research activity aims to develop an integrated methodology for assessing safety risks in hospital environments. The study will address non-structural, including suspended-ceiling collapse, water infiltration, falling components and failures affecting building systems. The project will combine on-site inspections, analysis of maintenance records, monitoring data and standardized risk indicators to identify vulnerabilities and prioritize corrective actions. The results will support the development of a digital platform for recording inspection findings, mapping hazards, managing photographic and technical documentation, and monitoring mitigation measures over time. item.description:

Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-11 Restauro e storia dell'architettura

The candidate must have a master's degree in Architecture, Architecture/Restoration, Architecture and Urban Regeneration, or related disciplines (LM4). Proven experience in historical-architectural, archival, and bibliographic research of multi-layered artifacts is a plus. This enables understanding the construction phases, clients, contractors, and the various restorations, with particular reference to the architectural complexes of Santa Maria in Campitelli in Rome and the Cathedral of Albano Laziale.
